content.short: Decentral Games is a DAO that builds games and social experiences in the Metaverse.
content.description: Decentral Games is a decentralized autonomous organization that builds immersive games and social experiences within the Metaverse. Its flagship title, ICE Poker, is touted as the first Metaverse poker platform, serving as a focal point for gameplay and community events. The project runs daily Metaverse experiences featuring prizes, live music, and additional activities that bring people together in virtual spaces. DG DAO members can submit proposals, vote on governance, and help shape the future of Decentral Games.
